headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: TSU (5)

summary: Max Verstappen won the United States Grand Prix Sprint from pole position, 9.5s ahead of Lewis Hamilton, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Yuki Tsunoda made the biggest climb, from P19 to P14.
Oscar Piastri had a day to forget, dropping from P5 to P10.
The stewards penalised RUS (5 second time penalty) and ZHO (5 second time penalty).
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 213 points over Sergio Perez.
